zh.summary: 以低保真四狀態草圖說明操作、條件與回饋，再用走讀修正設計，最後才細化視覺。
objectives: 用線框稿表示畫面內容、主要動作及狀態轉換。
從現有四狀態 SVG 建立可修改的 wireframe.svg 與文字註記。
說明靜態草圖能驗證的問題與尚不能證明的行為。

readingGuide.goal: 用線框稿表示畫面內容、主要動作及狀態轉換。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 可在瀏覽器開啟的四狀態 wireframe.svg，以及能重演缺件與修改路徑的 wireframe-notes.md。

sections.heading: 先確認操作與復原方式
paragraphs: 本課最重要的觀念：設計軟體時，不要急著把畫面做漂亮。應該先確認使用者看得懂、知道怎麼操作，遇到錯誤時也知道如何繼續。
Wireframe（線框稿）就是讓我們在真正開發軟體之前，用很簡單的方框、文字、按鈕和箭頭，先把操作方式排演一遍。
這不是只有 UI/UX 設計師才需要學的技術。產品經理、軟體工程師、AI Agent 開發者，甚至負責規劃醫院、銀行或政府數位服務的人，都可以使用。
本課核心是學會四件事：

1. 用低成本草圖表達使用者要看到什麼、做什麼。
2. 規劃正常、處理中、失敗與完成等不同狀態。
3. 讓別人實際走讀草圖，找出不合理的地方。
4. 分清楚草圖已經驗證什麼，以及哪些事情仍要透過真正的程式測試。

sections.heading: 一、為什麼軟體開發要先畫 Wireframe？
paragraphs:
想像你要開一家餐廳。

你請設計師幫你規劃店面，他立刻拿出非常漂亮的設計圖：大理石櫃檯、漂亮吊燈、木質桌椅，整間店很有質感。

但是開幕後，你才發現：

- 客人進門不知道要去哪裡點餐。
- 點完餐不知道應該在哪裡等候。
- 點錯餐時不知道怎麼修改。
- 付款失敗，系統卻顯示「訂單完成」。
- 服務人員從廚房到櫃檯的動線互相干擾。

問題不在裝潢不漂亮，而是整個服務流程沒有設計好。

軟體也是一樣。
開發一個網站時，你可以很快利用 React、Figma，甚至 AI Coding Agent 做出看起來專業的畫面。
但畫面漂亮，不代表使用者真的能完成工作。
這就是 Wireframe 的價值：在投入大量開發成本之前，先用便宜、容易修改的方式確認設計方向。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從需求到正式產品的設計流程
blocks.description: 箭頭表示典型設計順序；可以回到前面修正，不代表每個專案都必須瀑布式執行。

items.title: 需求與使用情境
items.body: 誰要解決什麼問題？

items.title: User Flow（使用者流程）
items.body: 使用者需要經過哪些步驟？

items.title: Wireframe（線框稿）
items.body: 每個畫面放什麼？按下去會怎樣？

items.title: Prototype（可操作原型）
items.body: 讓使用者試操作，驗證互動方式

items.title: 實作、測試與交付
items.body: 完成真正的業務邏輯、安全與品質驗證

paragraphs: 這是便於理解的典型順序，不代表每個專案都必須嚴格瀑布式執行。實務上可以在草圖、原型與需求之間反覆修正。
英國政府的 GOV.UK Service Manual 也強調，原型應用來探索與測試不同設計，並依目前要回答的問題，選擇紙筆草圖或可操作的程式原型。

sections.heading: 二、Wireframe 到底要畫什麼？
paragraphs:
先看一個實際例子。

假設我們準備為物流公司開發「出貨資料檢查系統」。
員工輸入三項資料：收件人、收件地址、聯絡電話。系統檢查三個欄位是否填寫，通過後就能預覽並匯出出貨資料草稿。
這裡先假設只檢查三欄是否有值，不驗證地址是否真實、電話是否正確。
我們不需要先決定按鈕要藍色還是綠色，而是先畫出四種情況。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜出貨資料檢查的四種畫面
blocks.description: 四格是獨立情境，不是固定四步。所有姓名與電話都是合成範例；示意按鈕不執行檢查。

items.title: ① 輸入中
items.body:
收件人 *
王小明

收件地址 *
請輸入地址

聯絡電話 *
0912-XXX-XXX

檢查資料

使用者知道要填什麼

items.title: ② 處理中
items.body:
出貨資料檢查

正在處理

資料已保留，請勿重複提交

檢查進行中

僅在實際需要等待時出現

items.title: ③ 資料缺漏
items.body:
還有 1 項資料需要補填

收件人：王小明

收件地址 *
請填寫收件地址

聯絡電話：已保留

補填後重新檢查

說清楚哪裡錯，且不清空其他欄位

items.title: ④ 檢查完成
items.body:
三欄完整性檢查通過

收件人：王小明
收件地址：已填寫
聯絡電話：0912-XXX-XXX

預覽／匯出資料

修改任一欄後，原檢查結果失效

paragraphs:
教學用低保真示意圖，不是真正執行檢查的互動介面。

注意，四種狀態不是要求使用者一定要依序經過四個畫面。
例如：

- 三欄都填好了，而且檢查非常快，可以直接從輸入進入完成。
- 地址沒有填寫，就應該進入缺漏狀態。
- 如果需要向遠端伺服器查詢，才可能出現處理中。
- 如果伺服器故障，這是技術失敗，不應該謊稱使用者忘記填資料。
這裡就出現一個重要的軟體工程概念：State（狀態）與 State Transition（狀態轉換）。

sections.heading: 三、真正重要的不是四張圖，而是它們之間怎麼連接
paragraphs:
一個常見的設計錯誤是，只畫使用者操作成功的情況。

例如：

使用者填完資料 → 按下送出 → 顯示成功。

這條路徑稱為 Happy Path（理想成功路徑）。
但現實世界永遠不只有成功的情況。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜出貨資料檢查的狀態轉換
blocks.description: 每列是起點 → 終點，列下方是觸發事件或條件；各列不是依序執行。判斷節點的兩條出口互斥。重試只適用本例的資料檢查，交易須先確認實際狀態。

items.title: 輸入資料 → 資料是否完整？
items.body: 按下檢查

items.title: 資料是否完整？ → 缺漏：指出要補哪欄
items.body: 否

items.title: 缺漏：指出要補哪欄 → 輸入資料
items.body: 補填並保留原值

items.title: 資料是否完整？ → 是否需要遠端處理？
items.body: 是

items.title: 是否需要遠端處理？ → 檢查完成
items.body: 否：本機檢查即完成

items.title: 是否需要遠端處理？ → 處理中
items.body: 是

items.title: 處理中 → 檢查完成
items.body: 成功

items.title: 處理中 → 技術失敗
items.body: 逾時或服務異常

items.title: 技術失敗 → 輸入資料
items.body: 重試

items.title: 檢查完成 → 輸入資料
items.body: 修改任一欄：舊檢查結果失效

items.title: 檢查完成 → 預覽／匯出
items.body: 資料未修改

paragraphs:
這張圖中的判斷節點代表「系統要做決定」，箭頭代表「什麼事件會讓狀態改變」。參考圖使用虛線圓角框表示判斷，並非菱形；形狀可以調整，條件與分支必須清楚。

我們用三個不同產業的場景理解其重要性。
銀行轉帳： 使用者輸入轉帳資料後，系統確認欄位都已填妥，不代表銀行已經完成轉帳。真正扣款成功需要另行確認。若交易逾時，也不能直接當成交易失敗後重新匯款，因為可能造成重複轉帳。
醫院預約： 病人填寫預約資料後，畫面顯示所有欄位已完成，不代表掛號成功。還必須確認系統真的保留到診次或名額。
AI Agent 工具： 使用者要求 Agent 產出研究報告。Agent 可能處於等待工具回應、資料不足、工具執行失敗、報告已生成但尚待人工確認等狀態。如果只畫「輸入指令」和「報告完成」，就會漏掉最需要治理的中間狀態。
共同原則是：
畫面上的成功訊息，必須對應到真正已經完成的事情，不能把尚未驗證的結果包裝成完成。

sections.heading: 四、為什麼畫面旁邊還要寫註記？
paragraphs:
線框稿本身只能表示畫面大致長什麼樣子，不能充分描述所有行為。

例如，你畫了一個「送出」按鈕。
開發者可能還是不知道：

- 按下去之後要不要鎖住按鈕？
- 網路斷線後要不要保留內容？
- 使用者能不能取消？
- 送出後修改資料，原本的審核是否仍有效？
因此需要 Annotation（行為註記）。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜將上傳結果畫成共同節點的分支
blocks.description: 依 Balsamiq 檔案上傳範例重製。上方對照重複路徑的問題，下方共用「檔案上傳中」後分支；失敗線用文字與虛線區分，顏色不是唯一提示。

items.title: 分開重複的路徑
items.body:
使用者上傳檔案 → 檔案上傳中 → 檔案上傳成功

使用者上傳檔案 → 檔案上傳中 → 檔案上傳失敗

items.title: 共用上傳中的狀態
items.body:
使用者上傳檔案 → 檔案上傳中

成功 → 檔案上傳成功

失敗 ⇢ 檔案上傳失敗

paragraphs:
參考圖：Balsamiq 的檔案上傳流程示例。上傳可能成功，也可能失敗，必須明確畫出分支。

本課要求的 wireframe-notes.md 就是用來記錄這些資訊。
例如，對物流系統可以這樣寫：

blocks.heading: wireframe-notes.md
paragraphs: 以下為合成設計註記範例。
blocks.code:
# 出貨資料 Wireframe 行為註記

## 檢查資料
觸發：使用者按下「檢查資料」
條件：檢查三項必填欄位

## 資料缺漏
顯示：指出未填寫的欄位
保留：其他已填資料
允許動作：補填、重新檢查

## 技術失敗
顯示：目前無法完成檢查
允許動作：安全重試或稍後再試
限制：不可宣告檢查成功

## 檢查通過
顯示：三欄完整性檢查通過
允許動作：預覽、匯出
限制：不代表地址或電話已驗證有效

## 完成後修改
觸發：修改任一欄位
結果：舊檢查結果失效
下一步：必須重新檢查

# Shipping-data wireframe behavior notes

## Check data
Trigger: user selects “Check data”
Condition: check the three required fields

## Missing data
Display: identify the omitted fields
Retain: all other entered values
Allowed actions: fill omissions and check again

## Technical failure
Display: the check cannot currently be completed
Allowed actions: safely retry or try later
Restriction: do not claim that checking succeeded

## Check passed
Display: three-field completeness check passed
Allowed actions: preview and export
Restriction: address and telephone validity remain unverified

## Edit after completion
Trigger: any field changes
Result: the previous check is invalidated
Next action: check again

paragraphs:
這份註記與線框稿互相補充：一份解釋畫面，一份交代規則。

特別要注意「完成後修改」。
假設病歷系統顯示資料已審核，醫師又修改了一項用藥資訊。若系統繼續顯示「已審核」，就可能讓人誤以為新內容也已通過審核。
所以這不只是 UI 問題，也涉及資料一致性、權限、工作流程與安全。

sections.heading: 五、低保真、中保真與高保真有什麼不同？
paragraphs: Fidelity（保真度）指的是設計稿與實際產品在外觀及互動細節上有多接近。

blocks.caption: 保真度與適用問題
rows: Low-fidelity 低保真
像紙上草圖，簡單方框與文字
欄位、動作和流程合理嗎？
Mid-fidelity 中保真
更精確的灰階版面與真實內容
資訊排列、閱讀順序清楚嗎？
High-fidelity 高保真
接近正式產品的視覺設計
字體、配色、視覺層級與細節合適嗎？
Interactive prototype 可操作原型
可以按按鈕、切換畫面、模擬互動
使用者操作起來是否順暢？

paragraphs: 這些類型不是完全互斥的；高保真畫面也可以做成可操作原型。
例如，建築師設計房子，可以先用手繪平面圖討論房間位置，再做精確建築圖，最後用 3D 模型或實體樣品測試體驗。
軟體設計也是同樣道理：不要用昂貴的驗證方式回答廉價草圖就能回答的問題，但也不要拿草圖宣稱已經通過真實互動測試。

sections.heading: 六、如何確認 Wireframe 真的有用？
paragraphs: 本課介紹 Walkthrough（走讀）：請另一個人沿著情境閱讀草圖，判斷他能不能理解接下來要做什麼。
以物流系統為例，可以給測試者兩張任務卡。

blocks.caption: 圖 5｜用兩張任務卡走讀草圖
blocks.description: 兩張卡是不同測試任務，不代表先後流程；先觀察理解，再記錄修正理由。

items.title: 任務 A：資料缺漏
items.body: 你正在準備出貨，但是忘記填寫收件地址。請指出介面上哪裡告訴你這件事，以及你應該如何補救。

items.title: 任務 B：完成後修改
items.body: 你已經完成資料檢查，後來發現電話填錯並修改了內容。請說明現在是否可以直接匯出已通過檢查的資料。

paragraphs:
走讀時，不要一開始就告訴測試者答案。

我們想觀察的是：草圖本身能不能提供足夠線索，讓人理解。
而且不同的驗證方法，能支持的結論不同：

blocks.caption: 驗證方法與證據界線
rows: 自己走讀
發現明顯設計矛盾
真正使用者也能理解
他人走讀
此人在指定情境如何理解草圖
所有使用者都能完成任務
可操作原型測試
指定設備和情境下的互動表現
正式系統的效能與安全
正式程式測試
被測試範圍內的程式行為
未涵蓋情境也完全可靠

paragraphs:
還有一個經常被忽略的面向：Accessibility（無障礙或可近用性）。

即使只是在畫黑白草圖，也要考慮欄位標籤、錯誤訊息與合理閱讀順序。
例如，不能只有一個紅框告訴使用者「這裡有錯」。W3C 的 WCAG 2.2 成功準則 3.3.1 要求，在自動偵測到輸入錯誤時，以文字指出出錯項目並描述錯誤。
不過，紙上標示了正確的閱讀順序，不代表實際程式已通過螢幕閱讀器或鍵盤操作測試。

sections.heading: 七、如何完成這一節的實作？
paragraphs:
正式教材要求保留兩項成果：

wireframe.svg 是可由瀏覽器顯示的四狀態線框圖。SVG 是 Scalable Vector Graphics（可縮放向量圖形），可以用文字編輯器修改圖中的文字與形狀。
wireframe-notes.md 是 Markdown 格式的行為說明，記錄狀態切換、輸入保留、錯誤復原、修改後重新檢查，以及尚未測試的事項。
可以依照這個順序練習：

1. 從教材的工作坊資源下載 aase-v1-workshop.zip。
2. 複製 reference/wireframe.svg，保留原始參考稿。
3. 將合成情境改成你選擇的產業，例如醫院掛號、物流出貨或銀行表單。
4. 修改 SVG 中的文字，確認瀏覽器能正常顯示、不會裁切。
5. 在 wireframe-notes.md 記下觸發條件、可採動作、失敗復原與修改規則。
6. 用缺漏和完成後修改兩個案例走讀，記錄至少一項修正理由。
這一節的實作重點不是做出可執行網站，而是交付一份別人看得懂、可以討論、能追溯設計理由的介面規格草稿。

sections.heading: 八、從這堂課帶走的工程觀念
paragraphs:
Wireframe 可以視為連接需求工程與軟體實作的橋梁。

M03 的需求工程回答「我們要解決什麼問題」；M04-03 的資訊架構回答「資訊應該如何組織」；M04-04 的 Wireframe 則把需求轉成具體畫面、動作和狀態。後面的規格驅動開發與測試，再將這些設計轉成程式可以驗證的規則。
因此，這堂課最值得記住的不是某個繪圖軟體的操作方法，而是：
每當你設計一個畫面，都要追問四件事：使用者現在知道什麼？能做什麼？接下來會發生什麼？出錯時怎麼回復？

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核
paragraphs: 請依照自己的理解作答，不需要使用正式術語。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
steps: 從工作坊頁下載並解壓 ZIP，複製 reference/wireframe.svg 為專案 wireframe.svg，以瀏覽器確認可開啟。
用編輯器修改一處 text 文字，重新整理確認未裁切；在 wireframe-notes.md 加上觸發、允許動作、輸入保留與回復路徑。
用缺件及修改兩張卡走讀，記錄一項修正理由；核對四格標題與靜態圖界線，保留尚待程式實測的項目。
exercise.expected: 可在瀏覽器開啟的四狀態 wireframe.svg，以及能重演缺件與修改路徑的 wireframe-notes.md。
exercise.check: 同儕或自查能指出各狀態下一步；SVG 按鈕不是實際功能，鍵盤與程式行為仍待實作驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考與自己的修訂版，不加入真實資料、外部圖片或腳本；紙筆替代尚未轉 SVG 時如實標記。

openChecks.prompt: 某醫院掛號系統的 Wireframe 畫出「姓名、身分證、看診日期」與「確認掛號」按鈕。這樣是否足以證明掛號流程完整？還缺少哪些重要狀態？
answer: 尚不足以證明完整。需要補上資料缺漏、真正需要等待時的處理中、技術失敗與安全復原、名額保留結果、完成後修改等狀態。欄位完整與實際掛號成功是不同結果。

openChecks.prompt: 使用者提交貸款申請資料，系統顯示「三個必填欄位完整」。此時能否把狀態直接顯示為「貸款審核通過」？請說明原因。
answer: 不能。三欄完整只證明目前必填資料有值；貸款審核另有資格、權限與業務規則，必須取得實際審核結果才可顯示通過。

openChecks.prompt: 一個 AI Agent 任務管理介面已畫出工作成功與失敗兩種畫面，但尚未實作。團隊能否因此宣稱已經驗證任務中斷、重試、權限與安全性？接下來應該用什麼方式驗證？
answer: 不能。草圖只能討論狀態與操作線索；接續要做可操作原型的情境走讀與鍵盤／焦點測試，以及真正程式的中斷、重試、權限、安全與資料保留測試。記錄測試範圍與尚待驗事項。

en.summary: Use low-fidelity four-state sketches to explain actions, conditions and feedback, revise through walkthroughs, then refine visual details.
objectives: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
Create an editable wireframe.svg and notes from the existing four-state SVG.
Explain what a static sketch can investigate and what behavior remains unproven.

readingGuide.goal: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.

sections.heading: Establish actions and recovery first
paragraphs: When designing software, first establish whether users understand the screen, know what to do, and can recover from errors. Visual polish comes after those questions.
A wireframe rehearses interactions before implementation using simple boxes, text, buttons and arrows.
UI/UX designers, product managers, software engineers, AI Agent developers, and people planning hospital, banking or government digital services can all use this technique.
This lesson develops four abilities:

1. Express what users need to see and do with inexpensive sketches.
2. Plan normal, processing, failure and completed states.
3. Ask someone else to walk through the sketch and identify confusing choices.
4. Distinguish evidence from a sketch from behavior that still requires executable software tests.

sections.heading: 1. Why draw a wireframe before developing software?
paragraphs: Imagine opening a restaurant. A designer immediately produces an attractive plan with marble counters, pendant lighting and wooden furniture.
After opening, however, you discover:

- Customers do not know where to order.
- After ordering, they do not know where to wait.
- They cannot work out how to correct an order.
- A failed payment still produces an “Order complete” message.
- Staff routes between the kitchen and counter interfere with each other.
The service workflow needs attention alongside the decoration.
Software has the same problem. React, Figma or an AI Coding Agent can quickly produce a professional-looking screen, yet that appearance alone does not establish that users can complete their work.
Wireframes let the team examine a direction cheaply, before investing heavily in implementation.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From requirements to a working product
blocks.description: Arrows show a typical design order. Earlier decisions can be revisited; this is not a mandatory waterfall process.

items.title: Requirements and scenario
items.body: Who needs to solve which problem?

items.title: User Flow
items.body: Which steps does the user take?

items.title: Wireframe
items.body: What appears on each screen, and what happens after activation?

items.title: Interactive prototype
items.body: Let people try the interaction

items.title: Implementation, testing and delivery
items.body: Verify real business logic, security and quality

paragraphs: This is a typical explanatory order, not a requirement for a strict waterfall process. A team can revise requirements, sketches and prototypes repeatedly.
The GOV.UK Service Manual recommends using prototypes to explore and test designs, choosing paper sketches or code prototypes according to the question being investigated.

sections.heading: 2. What belongs in a wireframe?
paragraphs: Consider a shipping-data checking system for a logistics company.
An employee enters three fields: recipient, delivery address and contact telephone. The system checks whether each field has a value, then allows preview and export of a shipping-data draft.
For this example, completeness checking does not establish that the address exists or the telephone number is valid.
Before choosing blue or green buttons, sketch four situations.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Four shipping-data screens
blocks.description: These are independent situations, not four mandatory steps. Names and telephone numbers are synthetic. Button labels do not run checks.

items.title: ① Input
items.body:
Recipient *
Wang Xiaoming

Delivery address *
Enter an address

Contact telephone *
0912-XXX-XXX

Check data

Users know what to enter

items.title: ② Processing
items.body:
Shipping-data check

Processing

Input retained; do not submit again

Check in progress

Only when an actual wait exists

items.title: ③ Missing data
items.body:
1 field still needs a value

Recipient: Wang Xiaoming

Delivery address *
Please enter the delivery address

Telephone: retained

Fill the omission and check again

Identify the problem and keep other values

items.title: ④ Check complete
items.body:
Three-field completeness check passed

Recipient: Wang Xiaoming
Address: entered
Telephone: 0912-XXX-XXX

Preview / export data

Any edit invalidates the previous check

paragraphs: These are low-fidelity teaching sketches. Their button labels do not execute checks.
Users do not have to visit all four screens in sequence:

- If all three fields are filled and checking is immediate, input can go directly to completion.
- An omitted address leads to the missing-data state.
- A remote server request may require a processing state.
- A server fault is a technical failure; do not describe it as missing user data.
These differences introduce states and state transitions: the current situation and the events that change it.

sections.heading: 3. Connect the screens through explicit transitions
paragraphs: A common mistake is drawing only the successful interaction: fill in the data → submit → display success. This is the happy path.
Real use also includes omissions, waits, faults and edits.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Shipping-data state transitions
blocks.description: Each row names a source → destination, followed by its event or condition. Rows are not sequential steps. Decision exits are alternatives. Retry applies to this data check; a transaction needs its actual status confirmed first.

items.title: Input → Data complete?
items.body: Select Check

items.title: Data complete? → Missing: identify the field
items.body: No

items.title: Missing: identify the field → Input
items.body: Fill omissions; retain other values

items.title: Data complete? → Remote processing needed?
items.body: Yes

items.title: Remote processing needed? → Check complete
items.body: No: local checking completes

items.title: Remote processing needed? → Processing
items.body: Yes

items.title: Processing → Check complete
items.body: Success

items.title: Processing → Technical failure
items.body: Timeout or service fault

items.title: Technical failure → Input
items.body: Retry

items.title: Check complete → Input
items.body: Edit any field: invalidate the previous check

items.title: Check complete → Preview / export
items.body: Data unchanged

paragraphs: Decision nodes express a condition, and directed connections name the events that change states. The supplied reference uses dashed rounded rectangles rather than diamonds for its decisions. The conditions and branches carry the meaning.
Three industry examples explain why this matters.

Bank transfer: complete fields do not establish that a bank has transferred money. Actual debit completion needs separate confirmation. A timed-out transaction may have executed, so immediately sending the transfer again can duplicate it.
Hospital appointment: complete appointment fields do not establish a successful booking. The system must actually reserve a session or available place.

AI Agent tool: a research-report task may be waiting for a tool, missing information, experiencing a tool failure, or holding a generated report for human review. Drawing only an instruction screen and a completed report omits important intermediate states.
A success message must describe what has actually been established. Unverified outcomes require a different status.

sections.heading: 4. Why add annotations beside a screen?
paragraphs: A wireframe shows a screen's approximate appearance but cannot fully specify its behavior.
A “Submit” button leaves several questions open:

- Should the button be locked after activation?
- Should entered content survive a lost connection?
- Can the user cancel?
- Does the previous approval remain valid if the data changes?
Behavior annotations record those rules.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | Branch from a shared upload state
blocks.description: Redrawn from the Balsamiq upload example. The first panel repeats paths; the second shares the uploading state and branches. Failure uses text and a dashed branch, so color is not the only cue.

items.title: Repeated separate paths
items.body:
User uploads file → File is uploading → File successfully uploads

User uploads file → File is uploading → File upload fails

items.title: Shared uploading state
items.body:
User uploads file → File is uploading

Success → File successfully uploads

Failure ⇢ File upload fails

paragraphs: The reference is Balsamiq's file-upload example. Uploading can end in success or failure; the alternative paths should share the same uploading state rather than being mistaken for two separate required processes.
Record these decisions in wireframe-notes.md. For the logistics example:

blocks.heading: wireframe-notes.md
paragraphs: The retained Chinese template specifies triggers, missing-field recovery, safe technical-failure handling, limited completion, and invalidation after edits.
blocks.code:
# 出貨資料 Wireframe 行為註記

## 檢查資料
觸發：使用者按下「檢查資料」
條件：檢查三項必填欄位

## 資料缺漏
顯示：指出未填寫的欄位
保留：其他已填資料
允許動作：補填、重新檢查

## 技術失敗
顯示：目前無法完成檢查
允許動作：安全重試或稍後再試
限制：不可宣告檢查成功

## 檢查通過
顯示：三欄完整性檢查通過
允許動作：預覽、匯出
限制：不代表地址或電話已驗證有效

## 完成後修改
觸發：修改任一欄位
結果：舊檢查結果失效
下一步：必須重新檢查

# Shipping-data wireframe behavior notes

## Check data
Trigger: user selects “Check data”
Condition: check the three required fields

## Missing data
Display: identify the omitted fields
Retain: all other entered values
Allowed actions: fill omissions and check again

## Technical failure
Display: the check cannot currently be completed
Allowed actions: safely retry or try later
Restriction: do not claim that checking succeeded

## Check passed
Display: three-field completeness check passed
Allowed actions: preview and export
Restriction: address and telephone validity remain unverified

## Edit after completion
Trigger: any field changes
Result: the previous check is invalidated
Next action: check again

paragraphs: The drawing explains the screen; the notes specify its rules.

Pay particular attention to editing after completion. If a doctor changes medication information after a medical record was reviewed, continuing to display “Reviewed” could falsely imply that the new content was approved too.
This affects data consistency, permissions, workflow and safety as well as interface design.

sections.heading: 5. Low, medium and high fidelity
paragraphs: Fidelity describes how closely a design resembles the eventual product's appearance and interaction detail.

blocks.caption: Fidelity and questions
rows: Low-fidelity
Paper-like boxes and text
Are fields, actions and flow reasonable?
Mid-fidelity
More precise grayscale layout with realistic content
Are information arrangement and reading order clear?
High-fidelity
Visual design close to the product
Are typography, color, hierarchy and detail appropriate?
Interactive prototype
Clickable controls, screen changes and simulated interaction
Can users operate the proposed interaction smoothly?

paragraphs: These categories can overlap. A high-fidelity screen can also be part of an interactive prototype.
An architect might first discuss room locations using a hand-drawn floor plan, then make precise drawings, and later test the experience with a 3D model or physical samples.
Choose a proportionate method for the question. Expensive validation is unnecessary when a cheap sketch can answer it; a sketch still cannot establish tested interactive behavior.

sections.heading: 6. How can you check whether a wireframe helps?
paragraphs: In a walkthrough, another person follows a scenario through the sketch and explains what to do next.
Give the logistics-system participant two task cards.

blocks.caption: Figure 5 | Two walkthrough task cards
blocks.description: Independent tasks, not sequential steps. Observe interpretation before recording a reason to revise.

items.title: Task A: missing data
items.body: You are preparing a shipment but forgot the delivery address. Identify where the interface tells you this and explain how to recover.

items.title: Task B: edit after completion
items.body: You completed the data check, then corrected the telephone number. Explain whether you can immediately export the data as already checked.

paragraphs: Do not reveal the answer at the start. Observe whether the sketch supplies enough clues for the person to understand the action.
Different methods support different conclusions:

blocks.caption: Verification methods and evidence limits
headers: What it does not directly establish
rows: Self-review
Obvious design contradictions were found
Actual users will understand it
Another person's walkthrough
How that person interpreted the sketch in the stated scenario
Every user can complete the task
Interactive prototype testing
Interaction behavior on the specified device and scenario
Production performance and security
Executable software tests
Program behavior within the tested scope
Reliability in untested situations

paragraphs: Accessibility also starts with sketches. Even a monochrome design should plan field labels, error text and sensible reading order.
A red border alone is insufficient error identification. WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 3.3.1 requires automatically detected input errors to identify the affected item and describe the error in text.
Planning a reading order on paper does not establish screen-reader or keyboard behavior in executable software.

sections.heading: 7. Complete the practice task
paragraphs: Retain two artifacts.
wireframe.svg is a browser-readable four-state wireframe. SVG means Scalable Vector Graphics; a text editor can change its labels and shapes.
wireframe-notes.md is a Markdown behavior specification covering transitions, retained input, error recovery, rechecking after edits and untested behavior.

1. Download aase-v1-workshop.zip from the workshop resources.
2. Copy reference/wireframe.svg and preserve the original reference.
3. Adapt the synthetic scenario to an industry such as hospital registration, logistics or a banking form.
4. Edit the SVG text and check that the browser displays it without clipping.
5. Record triggers, allowed actions, recovery and editing rules in wireframe-notes.md.
6. Walk through missing data and editing after completion, recording at least one reason for revision.
The deliverable is an understandable, discussable interface-specification draft with traceable design reasons. A working website is a later layer.

sections.heading: 8. Engineering ideas to retain
paragraphs: Wireframes connect requirements engineering with implementation.

M03 asks which problem to solve. M04-03 information architecture organizes the information. M04-04 turns requirements into screens, actions and states. Later specification-driven development and tests translate those decisions into executable rules.
For every screen, ask four questions: What does the user know now? What can they do? What happens next? How can they recover from an error?

sections.heading: 9. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Answer in your own words; formal terminology is unnecessary.

exercise.environment: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
steps: Download and extract the workshop ZIP, copy reference/wireframe.svg to your project as wireframe.svg and confirm it opens in a browser.
Edit one text element, refresh and check for clipping. Add triggers, allowed actions, input retention and recovery to wireframe-notes.md.
Walk through missing-input and edit cards and record one change reason. Check four-panel titles and static-image limits, retaining pending program tests.
exercise.expected: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.
exercise.check: A peer or self-review can identify the next action for each state. SVG buttons are not working features; keyboard and program behavior remain to be verified.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference and your revision. Add no real data, external images or scripts. Label a paper substitute honestly until converted to SVG.

openChecks.prompt: A hospital-registration wireframe contains name, identity number, appointment date and a “Confirm appointment” button. Does this establish a complete registration process? Which important states are missing?
answer: No. Add missing-data states, processing when a real wait exists, technical failure and safe recovery, reservation outcomes, and edits after completion. Complete fields and a confirmed booking are different results.

openChecks.prompt: A loan applicant submits data and the system says “Three required fields are complete.” Can the state now be labeled “Loan approved”? Explain why.
answer: No. Completeness only establishes that the current required fields have values. Loan approval requires separate eligibility, authority and business-rule checks plus an actual approval result.

openChecks.prompt: An AI Agent task interface has success and failure screens but has not been implemented. Can the team claim that interruption, retry, permissions and security have been verified? What should be tested next?
answer: No. Sketches support discussion of states and interaction cues. Next test an operable prototype through scenarios, keyboard and focus behavior, then test interruption, retry, permissions, security and retained data in real code. Record coverage and outstanding checks.
